action_items: No fixes required. All Iteration 4 acceptance criteria pass.

Optional housekeeping: server.py still uses sync `requests` inside async handlers for /api/mandi*, /api/weather (carry-over from iter 3). Migrate to httpx.AsyncClient before scaling. Low priority for current traffic.
Optional: site-footer is intentionally not on /admin and /admin/dashboard because those pages use AdminSidebar layout, not Layout. Confirm with PM if footer should also appear on admin shell.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 753 lines — borderline for splitting into routers (auth.py, mandi.py, weather.py, schemes.py, products.py, notifications.py). Consider before next major feature add.
AdSensePlaceholder cleanly gates real <ins class='adsbygoogle'> behind REACT_APP_ADSENSE_CLIENT + slotId; placeholder reserves identical h-{24,28,64} so no layout shift after AdSense approval. Good.
Footer.jsx links use react-router <Link> (no full reload). Good for SPA UX and AdSense.
ContactPage uses navigator.clipboard.writeText safely wrapped in try/catch and falls back gracefully. Good.
requirements.txt: matches spec exactly (fastapi, uvicorn[standard], motor, pymongo, pydantic[email], requests, PyJWT, bcrypt, python-dotenv). Slim and production-ready.

server.py uses `os.environ['JWT_SECRET']` (will fail-fast on missing env) and `os.environ.get('MONGO_URL')` (silent on missing) — minor inconsistency; consider hardening MONGO_URL to fail fast in prod.

Old admin email is hard-deleted on each startup via `delete_many({role: admin, email: $ne ADMIN_EMAIL})`. This is great for the single-admin invariant but if ADMIN_EMAIL is ever misconfigured, the legitimate admin row could be removed. Consider a feature-flag.
/api/notifications has no pagination cursor, only limit cap of 200 — fine for current scale; revisit when notifications > 1000.
